title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Rruga Dritan Hoxha, Tiranë
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 ne Laprake.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje ndertimi te vitit 2020,buze rruges kryesore Dritan Hoxha.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet te ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese sa me komode.
Apartamenti organizohet ne nje korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne ambientet e tjera, sallon se bashku me kuzhinen, dy dhoma gjumi njera prej te cilave eshte me tualet me dritare,tualeti kryesor dhe ballkoni.
Apartamenti ka nje investim +50.000 euro dhe shitet si ne foto.
Ai disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe eshte i mundur te shitet me kredi.
Disponon post parkimi me cmim ekstra.
Per nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Dritan Hoxha Street, Tirana
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Laprake. The apartment is part of a building of 2020, on the edge of the main Dritan Hoxha street. The area in which it is located offers all the facilities for a comfortable life. The apartment is organized in a corridor that distributes it to the other rooms, the living room together with the kitchen, two bedrooms, one of which has a bathroom with a window, the main bathroom and the balcony. The apartment has an investment of +50,000 euros and is sold as in the photo. It has regular mortgage documentation and can be sold on credit. There is a parking post at an extra cost. For a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me!
